documents.markdown:
# Fixture annotation provenance guide

This invented guide documents how transcript origins and notation layers stay separate in the test fixture.

## Transcript layers

| Layer | Notation example | Provenance note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Archived research | `[/]` and `(.)` | Invented research transcript with explicit `CHI` speaker labels |
| TalkBank AI draft | `PAR1` | Machine-generated fixture draft with unverified speakers |
| Local AI draft | `plain text \| JSON` | Local speech-recognition fixture without CHAT notation |

### Editorial markers

Synthetic boundary comments such as `[[SYNTHETIC NOTE |` and `| END SYNTHETIC NOTE]]` stay separate from transcript speech.
